note: Triennial election of the 19 electoral divisions of Dungannon rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twelve Unionists and five Nationalists were returned unopposed; Crossdernott and Coalisland were contested. The only new members named were at Clonaneese, Bush and Newmills (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 4). Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 2 June 1949 return (Killyman: W. Espey, Northern Whig, 18 May 1949, p. 4); the Belfast Telegraph, 12 June 1952, p. 5 names Mr. W. Espey as re-elected vice-chairman at the first meeting of the new council, and he was not co-opted. He died in January 1953 as vice-chairman of the council (Northern Whig, 19 January 1953, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
